scan_metadata.paper_name: OPEM: Open Source PEM Cell Simulation Tool
scan_metadata.explanation: Bounded first migration of the documented Amphlett static PEMFC API. One independently useful curve operation also returns the source-supported loss components. Air-cooled/open-cathode dynamics are deferred rather than inferred from a static model.

tutorials.title: Amphlett Static Model — Full Run
tutorials.description: Run the existing static polarization API with the official Full Run input vector and preserve native voltage, power, efficiency, and loss outputs.
tutorials.reason_for_include_or_exclude: Complete reusable PEMFC curve analysis on new physical operating parameters, using an existing public callable and directly reproducible official inputs. The reference executor may use a native Python driver extracted from cells65 and67/69 without executing installation/plot scaffolding.
reference_source_sections: Plot: cells78-82 only if plot outputs are included in execution scope

suggested_tools.description: Simulate a user-parameterized static hydrogen/oxygen PEMFC current sweep; return source-native stack voltage, stack power, native efficiency, losses, and optional native report files.

primary_input.PO2: oxygen partial pressure [atm], not cathode total pressure
primary_input.N: number of series cells, positive integer
primary_input.i-stop: exclusive current stop [A], capped natively at A*JMax
primary_input.Name: report basename [string]

outputs.Ph: native thermal-power proxy [W] using upstream Eth=1.23 V; not a validated stack heat-rejection model

tool_review.implementation: Repeated calls to opem.Static.Amphlett.Static_Analysis on explicitly changed native inputs.
tool_review.reason: The conversational agent can compose repeated curve calls; no new scientific algorithm is needed or claimed.

tool_review.candidate: air-cooled/open-cathode airflow, fan and thermal-water dynamics
tool_review.reason: Selected static source has fixed T and lambda inputs and no air velocity, fan speed/power, humidity evolution, or thermal-field state equations. Native Ph uses Eth=1.23 V and cannot certify heat rejection or fan sizing. Requires an actual open-cathode implementation plus traceable experimental/source validation.
No measured dataset or repository-backed calibration workflow was supplied; comparison and fitting cannot be claimed as converted OPEM methods.
